normalization_rules.name: Trim whitespace
normalization_rules.description: Remove unnecessary leading and trailing whitespace

normalization_rules.name: Normalize repeated spaces
normalization_rules.description: Convert multiple consecutive spaces into a single space

normalization_rules.name: Normalize line breaks
normalization_rules.description: Convert unnecessary line breaks into standard spacing

normalization_rules.name: Preserve meaning
normalization_rules.description: Do not change the meaning of the candidate's answer

normalization_rules.name: Preserve technical terms
normalization_rules.description: Do not alter valid technical terms, programming languages, tools or technologies

normalization_rules.name: Preserve raw transcript
normalization_rules.description: Keep the original transcript separately from the normalized transcript

normalization_rules.name: Confidence validation
normalization_rules.description: Ensure confidence values remain between 0 and 1
